stops.title: Udat Kin Du Wetin
stops.caption: Tu sistem rol, plɛnti grant.
stops.speech: Kairos de kip tu sistem rol nɔmɔ, admin ɛn mɛmba. Ɔl di ɔda tin na grant: wan rol we tay to wan spɛshal ples.

stops.title: Si am pan Akawnt
stops.caption: Opin di pɔsin, rid di grant dɛn.
stops.speech: Opin sɔmbɔdi ɛn yu kin si ɛvri grant we dɛn gɛt ɛn usay i de wok, we na di trutru ansa to wetin mek dɛn kin si wan pej.
